sanskrit:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान् ।
कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे ॥ १-२२॥
iast:
yāvadetānnirīkṣe’haṃ yoddhukāmānavasthitān
kairmayā saha yoddhavyamasmin raṇasamudyame 1-22
translation: In the midst of the two armies, place my chariot, O Achyuta, that I may behold those who stand here desirous of fighting and, on the eve of this battle, let me know with whom I must fight.
